newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power prices, volumes unchanged for Fri.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power prices, volumes unchanged for Fri.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left prices and volumes for Friday offers unchanged, and is still not offering power during peak demand hours, the federal agency said Thursday.
BPA continued to offer up to 500 megawatts (MW) of firm power during light load hours (0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST) and 300 of non-firm.
Friday firm prices were unchanged at $20.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for both Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
Prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 PST on Friday were steady at $20.50 per MWh for all deliveries and $24.00 for hours ending 0600 and 2300.
